title: Calling all SimGolf fans, developers and AI vibe coders!
author: PleasantScore8525
selftext:
Hey everyone!

As some of you may have seen, [SimGolf Remastered](https://github.com/finalpantasy/simgolf-mod) is bringing Sid Meier's SimGolf (2002) back with modern resolutions, widescreen support, smoother camera movement, updated UI and plenty of other improvements.

It's still a work in progress, and there are bugs that need tracking down and fixing.

I've started working on my own fork to help identify issues, investigate bugs and test possible fixes.

**My fork:** [https://github.com/heinrichh24-creator/simgolf-mod](https://github.com/heinrichh24-creator/simgolf-mod)

**Original project:** [https://github.com/finalpantasy/simgolf-mod](https://github.com/finalpantasy/simgolf-mod)

I'd love to get more of the SimGolf community involved.

You don't need to be an experienced programmer either. Whether you're a developer or someone who enjoys vibe coding with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or other AI coding tools, you can help.

**The idea is simple:**

* Fork the project and investigate bugs.
* Use AI tools to help understand the code, identify potential problems and suggest fixes.
* Test your changes and make sure they actually work in-game.
* Share reproducible bugs, screenshots, crash logs and potential solutions.
* Submit working fixes through GitHub pull requests so they can eventually benefit the original project.

Some areas worth investigating include overlapping UI elements, scaling problems, rendering glitches, crashes and gameplay bugs.

AI tools make it easier for people without years of programming experience to investigate complicated codebases, but we still need actual testing to distinguish working fixes from AI-generated guesses.

**The goal is to help the original project become more stable and playable by getting more people involved in identifying and fixing problems.**

Even if you don't code, simply playing the game, documenting bugs and sharing screenshots can help enormously.

After that the goal is IOS/ Andriod Apps for mobile
